scope: New pure engines, public runners, workflow publisher, HTML workbench and canonical code
observations: No external task RPC in models
Prototype-shaped reservation key handled through Map
HTML data inserted as text; frozen JSON escapes less-than characters
Loopback preview serves one file with external connections prohibited
Invocation and success latches prevent canonical replay
limitations: Public CLI request parsing was exercised on bounded supplied files; unbounded adversarial file-size handling is not a production claim
Browser SHA adapter is an interoperability demonstration, not a credential system
